functions.name: area
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the cross-section area of the beam elements.

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of beam component id.

functions.name: density
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the density of beam elements.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.beamarray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{beam} or float{beam,3}
functions.description: Get the beam extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: force
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the force at each end of the beam using the force-moment sign convention.

functions.name: force_nodal
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the generalized nodal force acting at each end in the global system. The end 1 translational and rotational components are given first.

functions.name: id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of beam element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return beam group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the length of the beam elements.

functions.name: load
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the uniform applied distributed load acting on the beam elements in the local y- and z-directions. The x-component of the return value will always be 0.0.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local coordinate system of beam elements.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the mark flag of beam elements.

functions.name: moment
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the moment at each end of the beam using the force-moment sign convention.

functions.name: moment_plastic
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in the beam.

functions.name: moment_plastic_y
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in Y in the beam.

functions.name: moment_plastic_z
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the plastic moment capacity in Z in the beam.

functions.name: poisson
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Poisson’s ratio of the beam elements.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of beam elements.

functions.name: set_area
functions.description: Set the cross-section area of the elements.

functions.name: set_density
functions.description: Set the density of beam elements.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.beamarray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{beam} or float{beam, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the beam extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.structure.beamarray.set_group(membership: array bool{beam}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set beam group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding beam to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_load
functions.description: Set the uniform applied distributed load acting on the beam elements in the local y- and z-directions. The x-component is ignored on assignment.

functions.name: set_mark
functions.description: Set the mark flag of beam elements.

functions.name: set_moment_plastic
functions.description: Set the plastic moment capacity in the beam.

functions.name: set_moment_plastic_y
functions.description: Set the plastic moment capacity in Y in the beam.

functions.name: set_moment_plastic_z
functions.description: Set the plastic moment capacity in Z in the beam.

functions.name: set_poisson
functions.description: Set the Poisson’s ratio of the beam elements.

functions.name: set_thermal_expansion
functions.description: Set the thermal expansion coefficient of beam elements.

functions.name: set_young
functions.description: Set the Youngs modulus of the beam elements.

functions.name: thermal_expansion
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the thermal expansion coefficient of beam elements.

functions.name: type
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the type name of beam elements.

functions.name: volume
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the beam elements volume, equal to the cross-sectional area times the length.

functions.name: ydir
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the y-axis of the beam elements local system.

functions.name: young
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Youngs modulus of the beam elements.
